# Floe — Working Capital for AI Agents

> Floe is the credit bureau and capital rail for AI agents. Deposit USDC, borrow up to 95% as working capital (same-token, no price risk). Also supports WETH/cbBTC collateral. Fixed rates, per-loan isolated escrow, gas-free for agents. 3,000+ lines issued, zero defaults. Live on Base mainnet. Dashboard: dev-dashboard.floelabs.xyz.

This file is a structured map of the Floe documentation, optimized for LLM agents reading it as part of a tool loop. Each page can also be queried directly by appending `?ask=<question>` to the URL — the response includes citations.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/): What Floe is and where to start by audience
- [How Floe Works (Core Concepts)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/getting-started/core-concepts): Intents, isolated loans, matching, LTV, oracles

## Quick starts

- [Quick Start (Humans)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Borrow / lend in 5 minutes via web app
- [Quick Start (Agents)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/quickstart-agents): Install SDK / connect MCP / first action call

## For agent operators

- [Bank Account → First API Call](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/fiat-to-x402): Fund with a bank account or card, get a USDC credit line, call any x402 API — no crypto experience needed
- [Credit for Agents](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents): Why agents pre-fund today, why that's broken, how Floe replaces it with secured working capital

## Key facts for retrieval

- **Network**: Base mainnet (chain ID 8453)
- **Loan tokens**: USDC, USDT
- **Collateral**: USDC (primary, same-token market at 95% LTV), WETH, cbBTC
- **Primary market**: USDC/USDC — deposit USDC, borrow up to 95% as working capital, hardcoded 1:1 oracle, no price risk
- **Lending matcher proxy**: 0x17946cD3e180f82e632805e5549EC913330Bb175
- **Facilitator EOA**: 0x58EDdE022FFDAD3Fb0Fb0E7D51eb05AaF66a31f1
- **Credit model**: Secured, fixed rate, fixed term. USDC/USDC has no price-volatility liquidation risk.
- **Gas**: Sponsored by Floe for agents using the x402 facilitator
- **Fiat on-ramp**: Buy USDC via Coinbase (credit card / bank transfer) from the Developer Dashboard
- **Multi-agent**: Up to 5 agents per developer, each with independent credit line
- **AgentKit actions**: 45 total (30 Floe + 6 x402 + 9 agent-awareness)
- **MCP tools**: 36 (12 read + 9 write + 3 analysis + 3 utility + 9 agent-awareness)
- **Agent-awareness primitives**: get_credit_remaining, get_loan_state, {get,set,clear}_spend_limit, {list,register,delete}_credit_threshold, estimate_x402_cost
- **npm**: `floe-agent` (v0.3.0), `@floelabs/mcp-server` (v0.2.0)
- **PyPI**: `floe-agentkit-actions` (v0.3.0)
- **MCP endpoint**: https://mcp.floelabs.xyz/mcp
- **Distribution**: AgentKit, MCP, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, ElizaOS, Crossmint GOAT, Virtuals ACP

## Querying these docs

Append `?ask=<your question>` to any page URL. Example:

```
GET https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents?ask=How+does+an+agent+borrow+USDC
```

Returns a direct natural-language answer with citations.
